name: Waterwheel Head Surveys
mechanism: Compare available head and discharge before selecting a wheel site
operating_requirement: Survey workers and seasonal flow observations
consequence: Reject sites unable to support the intended shaft load

name: Overshot Waterwheels
mechanism: Water admitted above the axle transfers gravitational energy through bucket loading
operating_requirement: Head race, wheel, maintained buckets and seasonal water
consequence: Deliver local shaft work while sufficient flow exists

name: Undershot Waterwheels
mechanism: Moving stream water pushes submerged blades
operating_requirement: Anchored wheel and an adequate current
consequence: Use low-head rivers with lower conversion efficiency

name: Breastshot Waterwheels
mechanism: Water enters near axle height and acts through a confined curved passage
operating_requirement: Masonry breast, wheel and controlled inlet
consequence: Exploit moderate heads with measured leakage losses

name: Waterwheel Gate Control
mechanism: Vary inlet flow to match changing shaft demand
operating_requirement: Gate, linkage and assigned operator
consequence: Avoid excessive wheel speed and unnecessary water use

name: Millpond Storage
mechanism: Store inflow behind a controlled outlet to separate supply timing from demand
operating_requirement: Embankment, spillway and finite reservoir
consequence: Run a mill temporarily when current inflow is insufficient

name: Impulse Turbines
mechanism: A high-speed water jet changes momentum against shaped buckets
operating_requirement: Pressure pipe, nozzle, rotor and head
consequence: Produce shaft work from high-head water

name: Reaction Turbines
mechanism: Pressure and velocity changes through submerged passages exert torque
operating_requirement: Pressure casing, runner and controlled outlet
consequence: Convert medium-head water into rotating work

name: Adjustable-Blade Turbines
mechanism: Change runner pitch with flow to maintain useful operating conditions
operating_requirement: Movable blade hubs and governors
consequence: Broaden efficient operation across variable discharge

name: Turbine Cavitation Control
mechanism: Keep local pressure above damaging vapor-cavity conditions
operating_requirement: Pressure observations, suitable setting and maintenance
consequence: Reduce erosion at the cost of restricted operating range

name: Hydroelectric Generation
mechanism: Couple hydraulic shaft power to a generator
operating_requirement: Water rights, turbine, generator and staffed switchgear
consequence: Provide electricity limited by flow and head

name: Pumped Hydro Storage
mechanism: Spend electricity lifting water and recover part during descent
operating_requirement: Two reservoirs, reversible machinery and finite water
consequence: Shift electrical supply across time with energy losses

name: Windmill Sail Control
mechanism: Adjust exposed sail area to changing wind force
operating_requirement: Sails, rigging and a miller
consequence: Regulate wind-driven machinery without constant output

name: Windmill Yaw Control
mechanism: Turn the rotor plane toward the wind
operating_requirement: Rotating cap or yaw bearing and control linkage
consequence: Reduce misalignment losses

name: Airfoil Wind Rotors
mechanism: Shaped blades generate torque mainly through aerodynamic lift
operating_requirement: Manufactured blades, tower and bearings
consequence: Convert a bounded wind-speed range to shaft work

name: Wind Turbine Pitch Control
mechanism: Change blade pitch to limit torque and regulate power
operating_requirement: Actuators, sensors and fail-safe controls
consequence: Curtail generation in damaging winds

name: Wind Generator Conversion
mechanism: Match variable rotor speed to an electrical generator
operating_requirement: Gearbox or direct drive and electrical conversion
consequence: Supply variable electricity with conversion losses

name: Wind Resource Assessment
mechanism: Estimate distributions of wind speed and direction from observations
operating_requirement: Masts, instruments and a sufficiently long record
consequence: Choose sites using expected output and uncertainty

name: Solar Thermal Collectors
mechanism: Absorb sunlight into a fluid while restricting heat loss
operating_requirement: Collector area, piping and a usable heat load
consequence: Provide weather-dependent low-temperature heat

name: Solar Concentrators
mechanism: Mirrors redirect sunlight onto a smaller receiver
operating_requirement: Reflectors, tracking and clear-sky radiation
consequence: Reach higher temperatures with optical losses

name: Thermal Storage Tanks
mechanism: Retain sensible heat in an insulated finite mass
operating_requirement: Tank, storage medium and heat exchanger
consequence: Delay heat use while losing energy to surroundings

name: Phase-Change Heat Storage
mechanism: Store latent heat during a controlled material transition
operating_requirement: Compatible containment and selected phase-change medium
consequence: Buffer heat near a transition temperature

name: Concentrated Solar Power
mechanism: Use concentrated solar heat to drive a thermodynamic engine
operating_requirement: Receiver, engine, cooling and generator
consequence: Produce dispatch-limited electricity from sunlight and stored heat

name: Geothermal Resource Testing
mechanism: Measure subsurface temperature, flow and reservoir response
operating_requirement: Test wells, pumps and monitoring
consequence: Distinguish heat in rock from an exploitable reservoir

name: Geothermal Heat Exchange
mechanism: Transfer reservoir heat through a circulating working fluid
operating_requirement: Wells, piping and corrosion management
consequence: Provide heat while reservoir and flow remain adequate

name: Binary Geothermal Cycles
mechanism: A secondary working fluid extracts useful work from moderate-temperature heat
operating_requirement: Heat exchanger, turbine and condenser
consequence: Generate electricity without passing reservoir fluid through the turbine

name: Combined Heat and Power
mechanism: Use otherwise rejected engine heat near an appropriate demand
operating_requirement: Generator, heat exchanger and nearby heat consumers
consequence: Improve useful energy recovery without creating additional fuel

name: District Heating Loops
mechanism: Circulate heat through a shared supply-and-return pipe system
operating_requirement: Insulated pipes, pumps and connected buildings
consequence: Deliver heat with distance and pumping losses

name: Heat Pump Cycles
mechanism: Spend work to move heat from a colder source to a warmer sink
operating_requirement: Compressor, exchangers and suitable temperature difference
consequence: Deliver heat exceeding input work by extracting environmental heat

name: Ground-Source Heat Pumps
mechanism: Use the shallow ground as a heat source or sink
operating_requirement: Ground loop, pump and sufficient ground exchange capacity
consequence: Moderate seasonal heating and cooling loads

name: Boiler Feedwater Treatment
mechanism: Remove scale-forming and corrosive constituents before heating
operating_requirement: Treatment plant, chemicals and testing
consequence: Reduce fouling and boiler damage through consumable treatment

name: Steam Condensers
mechanism: Condense exhaust steam at reduced pressure and recover feedwater
operating_requirement: Cooling source, condenser and vacuum integrity
consequence: Improve steam-cycle work while adding cooling demand

name: Steam Superheating
mechanism: Raise steam temperature above saturation before expansion
operating_requirement: Heat-resistant tubes and controlled combustion
consequence: Improve expansion conditions within material limits

name: Regenerative Feed Heating
mechanism: Use extracted steam to preheat feedwater
operating_requirement: Heaters, piping and controlled bleed flows
consequence: Trade some turbine flow for reduced boiler heat demand

name: Gas Turbine Cycles
mechanism: Compress air, add heat and expand hot gas through a turbine
operating_requirement: Compressor, combustion chamber and heat-resistant turbine
consequence: Produce shaft work with continuous fuel and airflow

name: Combined-Cycle Generation
mechanism: Use gas-turbine exhaust heat to supply a second steam cycle
operating_requirement: Heat recovery boiler, steam turbine and cooling
consequence: Recover more electrical work from a fuel stream

name: Generator Excitation Control
mechanism: Adjust magnetic excitation to control terminal electrical conditions
operating_requirement: Exciter, sensing and regulator
consequence: Maintain voltage within a defined operating envelope

name: Alternating-Current Distribution
mechanism: Transform voltage between generation, transmission and use
operating_requirement: Transformers, insulated conductors and protection
consequence: Trade voltage for current to manage resistive losses

name: Three-Phase Power
mechanism: Displaced alternating phases transfer power and form rotating fields
operating_requirement: Compatible machines, three conductors and phase control
consequence: Support efficient rotating machinery and shared power delivery

name: Protective Circuit Breakers
mechanism: Interrupt a circuit when measured fault conditions exceed limits
operating_requirement: Rated interrupters and coordinated trip settings
consequence: Limit fault duration while disconnecting affected supply

name: Grid Synchronization
mechanism: Match phase, frequency and voltage before connecting generators
operating_requirement: Instrumentation, control and switching equipment
consequence: Connect sources without excessive transient currents

name: Load Dispatch
mechanism: Allocate available generation against demand and operating constraints
operating_requirement: Telemetry, staffed control and controllable sources
consequence: Balance supply while respecting fuel and equipment limits

name: Transmission Stability
mechanism: Analyze whether linked machines retain acceptable motion after disturbances
operating_requirement: System models, observations and protective controls
consequence: Restrict transfers or isolate faults before widespread instability

name: High-Voltage Direct Current
mechanism: Convert between alternating supply and a controlled direct-current link
operating_requirement: Converter stations, insulation and line capacity
consequence: Carry bulk power with conversion cost and distinct control requirements

name: Grid-Forming Inverters
mechanism: A controlled converter establishes a local voltage waveform
operating_requirement: Power electronics, energy source and control reserve
consequence: Support an islanded electrical system within finite power limits

name: Islandable Microgrids
mechanism: Separate and rebalance a local electrical island when an upstream link fails
operating_requirement: Local generation, switchgear and adequate reserves
consequence: Maintain prioritized loads while shedding unsupported demand

name: Black-Start Planning
mechanism: Sequence self-starting sources and loads to rebuild a de-energized grid
operating_requirement: Start-capable equipment, stored energy and rehearsed crews
consequence: Restore supply without assuming the grid already operates

name: Battery State Estimation
mechanism: Infer usable charge from current, voltage, temperature and a cell model
operating_requirement: Sensors, computation and calibrated storage models
consequence: Avoid treating nominal capacity as available energy

name: Battery Thermal Management
mechanism: Control cell temperature during charging and discharge
operating_requirement: Thermal paths, sensors and cooling power
consequence: Reduce thermal stress while consuming auxiliary energy

name: Flow Battery Storage
mechanism: Store electroactive liquids separately and circulate them through a cell stack
operating_requirement: Electrolyte tanks, membranes, pumps and conversion equipment
consequence: Separate stored-energy volume from stack power rating

name: Hydrogen Storage Systems
mechanism: Contain hydrogen with compatible seals and controlled pressure or temperature
operating_requirement: Rated vessels, leak detection and handling procedures
consequence: Retain a finite hydrogen inventory with losses and hazards

name: Fuel Cell Stacks
mechanism: Combine fuel and oxidant electrochemically across controlled electrodes
operating_requirement: Catalysts, electrolyte, reactant supply and thermal management
consequence: Produce electricity while consuming chemical reactants

name: Electrolyzer Load Control
mechanism: Adjust hydrogen production to available electricity and process limits
operating_requirement: Controllable electrolyzers, water and gas handling
consequence: Absorb surplus power into a finite chemical inventory

name: Nuclear Fuel Fabrication
mechanism: Prepare and enclose reactor fuel to defined composition and dimensions
operating_requirement: Specialized facilities, containment and verified material records
consequence: Supply a specified reactor without granting generic nuclear operation

name: Reactor Heat Removal
mechanism: Move reactor heat through a maintained coolant circuit
operating_requirement: Pumps or passive circulation, exchangers and coolant inventory
consequence: Keep temperatures within design limits during defined conditions

name: Reactor Shutdown Systems
mechanism: Introduce negative reactivity through independent shutdown mechanisms
operating_requirement: Qualified absorbers, sensing and actuators
consequence: Stop the chain reaction while decay heat still requires removal

name: Decay Heat Management
mechanism: Provide cooling after fission power falls because radioactive decay continues
operating_requirement: Long-duration heat sinks and reliable coolant paths
consequence: Avoid mistaking shutdown for an immediate end to cooling demand

name: Nuclear Waste Characterization
mechanism: Measure radionuclide inventory and material form before selecting handling
operating_requirement: Shielded sampling, assay and chain of custody
consequence: Assign storage and isolation requirements to actual waste

name: Fusion Plasma Confinement
mechanism: Attempt to retain a hot plasma long enough for useful fusion conditions
operating_requirement: Specialized magnets or inertial drivers and diagnostic systems
consequence: Enable confinement experiments; net power is not assumed

name: Fusion Power Integration
mechanism: Combine a demonstrated fusion source with heat recovery and plant energy accounting
operating_requirement: Validated source, materials, fuel cycle and auxiliary power budget
consequence: Only a positive verified net energy balance enables power delivery

name: Angular Sky Catalogs
mechanism: Record repeatable angular positions of visible sky objects
operating_requirement: Calibrated sights, records and repeated observations
consequence: Compare sky positions without assuming physical distances

name: Planetary Motion Tables
mechanism: Fit repeated apparent planetary positions into predictive tables
operating_requirement: Long observational records and trained calculators
consequence: Predict apparent positions with quantified residual errors

name: Celestial Reference Frames
mechanism: Specify axes, origins and epochs for positional measurements
operating_requirement: Agreed conventions and maintained reference observations
consequence: Make observations from different sites comparable

name: Orbital Dynamics
mechanism: Predict trajectories under gravitational acceleration
operating_requirement: Measured initial conditions and suitable force models
consequence: Estimate orbital paths rather than treating spaceflight as straight travel

name: Orbit Determination
mechanism: Infer a trajectory from uncertain observations over time
operating_requirement: Tracking observations, computation and calibrated clocks
consequence: Update orbit estimates with uncertainty

name: Launch Window Planning
mechanism: Choose departure times compatible with target geometry and vehicle limits
operating_requirement: Trajectory calculation and actual vehicle performance
consequence: Restrict departure opportunities by achievable trajectories

name: Rocket Nozzle Expansion
mechanism: Expand hot gas through a shaped nozzle to produce directed exhaust momentum
operating_requirement: Heat-resistant nozzle and pressurized gas source
consequence: Produce measurable thrust with pressure-dependent losses

name: Rocket Propellant Feed
mechanism: Deliver controlled propellant flows to a combustion chamber
operating_requirement: Compatible tanks, valves and feed system
consequence: Support sustained firing while finite propellants remain

name: Liquid Rocket Engines
mechanism: Combine separately stored propellants in a controlled thrust chamber
operating_requirement: Qualified propellants, injectors, ignition and cooling
consequence: Produce controllable rocket impulse at actual propellant cost

name: Solid Rocket Motors
mechanism: A shaped solid propellant grain burns inside a pressure casing
operating_requirement: Prepared grain, casing, nozzle and ignition
consequence: Deliver a largely predetermined thrust history

name: Rocket Staging
mechanism: Discard expended structural mass between propulsion phases
operating_requirement: Separation mechanisms and independently qualified stages
consequence: Improve achievable velocity while introducing separation risk

name: Launch Vehicle Guidance
mechanism: Steer a vehicle using measured motion and a target trajectory
operating_requirement: Sensors, computation and control authority
consequence: Correct deviations within remaining propellant and actuator limits

name: Inertial Navigation Platforms
mechanism: Integrate accelerometer and rotation measurements to estimate motion
operating_requirement: Calibrated inertial sensors and initialization
consequence: Navigate without continuous external fixes while errors accumulate

name: Launch Range Tracking
mechanism: Track a rising vehicle with coordinated ground measurements
operating_requirement: Tracking stations, timing and communication links
consequence: Estimate flight progress and detect major deviations

name: Cryogenic Propellant Storage
mechanism: Retain low-temperature fluids with insulation and pressure control
operating_requirement: Insulated tanks, venting and compatible transfer hardware
consequence: Hold finite propellant inventories with boil-off losses

name: Rocket Engine Turbopumps
mechanism: Turbine-driven pumps supply high chamber pressure without equally heavy tanks
operating_requirement: High-speed pumps, seals and suitable turbine drive
consequence: Raise engine feed pressure within cavitation and thermal limits

name: Regenerative Rocket Cooling
mechanism: Circulate propellant through chamber passages before injection
operating_requirement: Manufactured channels and adequate coolant flow
consequence: Limit chamber wall temperature while transferring heat to fuel

name: Spacecraft Structural Testing
mechanism: Qualify payload structures against launch vibration and loading
operating_requirement: Test fixtures, representative loads and inspection
consequence: Reject assemblies unable to survive the specified launch environment

name: Spacecraft Attitude Sensing
mechanism: Combine external references and inertial observations to estimate orientation
operating_requirement: Star or sun sensors, inertial sensors and processing
consequence: Know pointing direction within sensor uncertainty

name: Reaction-Wheel Control
mechanism: Exchange angular momentum between spacecraft and internal wheels
operating_requirement: Wheels, drives, power and momentum management
consequence: Adjust orientation until wheel saturation or failure limits control

name: Spacecraft Thruster Control
mechanism: Apply small directed impulses to change orientation or trajectory
operating_requirement: Thrusters, valves and finite propellant
consequence: Perform corrections at measurable propellant cost

name: Orbital Rendezvous
mechanism: Match position and velocity with a target using relative-motion planning
operating_requirement: Tracking, guidance and adequate maneuver reserve
consequence: Approach another spacecraft without assuming immediate docking

name: Spacecraft Docking
mechanism: Align and mechanically capture two vehicles under limited relative motion
operating_requirement: Compatible interfaces, sensors and capture mechanisms
consequence: Join vehicles when alignment and approach conditions are satisfied

name: Orbital Transfer Planning
mechanism: Trade transfer time, impulse and trajectory constraints between orbits
operating_requirement: Trajectory tools and verified propulsion capability
consequence: Choose feasible transfers instead of spending arbitrary travel points

name: Gravity-Assist Navigation
mechanism: Exchange momentum with a moving gravitating body during a planned flyby
operating_requirement: Accurate ephemerides, tracking and trajectory correction
consequence: Alter heliocentric trajectory within encounter geometry

name: Electric Space Propulsion
mechanism: Use electrical energy to accelerate reaction mass
operating_requirement: Power supply, thruster and propellant feed
consequence: Accumulate velocity through low continuous thrust

name: Plasma Physics
mechanism: Model collective behavior of charged particles and fields
operating_requirement: Plasma sources, diagnostics and mathematical models
consequence: Provide a foundation for controlled discharge and propulsion experiments

name: Spacecraft Thermal Balance
mechanism: Balance radiation, internal dissipation and absorbed external heat
operating_requirement: Thermal model, surface treatments and measured loads
consequence: Identify temperatures incompatible with equipment or crew operation

name: Space Radiators
mechanism: Reject waste heat by thermal radiation from exposed surfaces
operating_requirement: Radiator area, fluid transport and unobstructed view
consequence: Limit continuous power use by available heat rejection

name: Multilayer Space Insulation
mechanism: Separated reflective layers reduce radiative heat exchange
operating_requirement: Low-conductance spacers and vacuum-compatible sheets
consequence: Reduce heat transfer without eliminating conduction paths

name: Space Power Arrays
mechanism: Orient and condition solar-array output for a spacecraft load
operating_requirement: Qualified arrays, deployment and power electronics
consequence: Provide sunlight-dependent electrical supply

name: Space Power Eclipse Reserves
mechanism: Reserve stored energy for periods without usable sunlight
operating_requirement: Batteries, load prediction and priority control
consequence: Sustain selected loads across finite eclipses

name: Space Radiation Shielding
mechanism: Use material and geometry to reduce specified radiation exposures
operating_requirement: Mass budget, exposure model and measured particle environment
consequence: Reduce dose with material-dependent secondary-radiation tradeoffs

name: Orbital Environment Monitoring
mechanism: Track debris and environmental conditions relevant to operations
operating_requirement: Sensors, catalogs and maintained observations
consequence: Inform avoidance and equipment-protection decisions

name: Collision-Avoidance Maneuvers
mechanism: Alter a trajectory when a predicted close approach warrants action
operating_requirement: Uncertain conjunction estimates and maneuver reserve
consequence: Trade propellant and mission disturbance for reduced encounter risk

name: Controlled Reentry
mechanism: Plan atmospheric entry to manage deceleration, heating and landing region
operating_requirement: Entry vehicle, navigation and atmospheric estimates
consequence: Reach a defined return corridor within vehicle limits

name: Ablative Heat Shields
mechanism: Sacrificial material absorbs and carries away entry heat
operating_requirement: Qualified ablative material and structural backing
consequence: Protect a vehicle while consuming shield material

name: Reusable Thermal Protection
mechanism: Low-conductance high-temperature surfaces limit heat reaching structure
operating_requirement: Insulating tiles or panels and inspection
consequence: Permit reuse only after damage and thermal qualification

name: Surface Descent Navigation
mechanism: Estimate motion relative to a surface and control a landing trajectory
operating_requirement: Altitude and velocity sensing with adequate propulsion
consequence: Land within terrain and residual-fuel limits

name: Planetary Rover Mobility
mechanism: Manage traction and obstacle traversal on uncertain terrain
operating_requirement: Wheels or tracks, suspension, sensors and energy
consequence: Move a payload subject to slip, terrain and power constraints

name: Remote Manipulation
mechanism: Control an instrumented manipulator while observing contact and motion
operating_requirement: Actuators, sensing and suitable operator feedback
consequence: Handle tools or payloads with limited force and reach

name: Space-Suit Pressure Systems
mechanism: Maintain a wearable pressure boundary with joints and life-support connections
operating_requirement: Qualified suit materials, seals and gas inventory
consequence: Permit external activity for a bounded duration

name: Spacecraft Atmosphere Control
mechanism: Monitor and regulate cabin gas pressure and composition
operating_requirement: Gas stores, valves, sensors and removal systems
consequence: Maintain specified breathable conditions while resources last

name: Gas Composition Analysis
mechanism: Measure components of a gas mixture using calibrated separation or spectral response
operating_requirement: Sampling equipment, references and trained analysts
consequence: Detect composition changes instead of inferring them from total pressure

name: Carbon-Dioxide Removal
mechanism: Remove accumulated carbon dioxide with sorbents or regenerable separation
operating_requirement: Air circulation, sorbent capacity and regeneration energy
consequence: Control cabin carbon dioxide with finite consumable or power costs

name: Cabin Oxygen Regeneration
mechanism: Generate replacement oxygen while accounting for separated gases and water
operating_requirement: Electrolyzer, water supply and gas handling
consequence: Reduce stored oxygen dependence without closing every life-support loop

name: Space Water Recovery
mechanism: Collect and process wastewater and humidity condensate for reuse
operating_requirement: Treatment train, filters, energy and quality verification
consequence: Recover part of used water with residual waste and losses

name: Closed-Habitat Material Accounts
mechanism: Track flows and losses of water, gases, food and waste within a habitat
operating_requirement: Sensors, inventories and accountable operations
consequence: Expose recurring resupply needs and unexplained losses

name: Habitat Fire Control
mechanism: Detect and suppress combustion within a constrained atmosphere
operating_requirement: Detection, isolation, extinguishing equipment and crew procedures
consequence: Limit fire damage while protecting remaining atmosphere

name: Orbital Habitat Assembly
mechanism: Join qualified habitation modules and commission shared services
operating_requirement: Launch capacity, interfaces, crew and external manipulation
consequence: Create usable habitat capacity only after services are operating

name: Rotating Habitat Dynamics
mechanism: Use rotation to create an effective acceleration while managing balance and motion coupling
operating_requirement: Rotating structure, bearings or free-flight design and control
consequence: Support artificial-gravity experiments; human tolerance must be demonstrated

name: Regolith Excavation
mechanism: Move granular surface material under local gravity and contact conditions
operating_requirement: Excavator, wear parts, power and dust control
consequence: Supply handled regolith at finite excavation cost

name: Regolith Volatile Assays
mechanism: Heat and analyze samples to estimate recoverable volatile content
operating_requirement: Representative sampling, controlled heating and analysis
consequence: Distinguish detectable traces from useful extractable reserves

name: Lunar Oxygen Extraction
mechanism: Release oxygen from qualified local feedstock through a selected chemical or electrochemical process
operating_requirement: Demonstrated feedstock, reactors, consumables and power
consequence: Produce oxygen only where the chosen process and resource are viable

name: In-Situ Construction Materials
mechanism: Process local material into qualified structural or shielding elements
operating_requirement: Material trials, processing equipment and inspection
consequence: Replace some imported mass with locally produced components

name: Planetary Surface Power
mechanism: Combine local generation and storage against surface illumination and thermal conditions
operating_requirement: Installed generators, storage and maintained distribution
consequence: Power surface loads through a specified environmental cycle

name: Deep-Space Tracking
mechanism: Recover weak spacecraft signals and measure timing or frequency for navigation
operating_requirement: Large receiving systems, calibrated clocks and scheduled contact
consequence: Update remote trajectory estimates subject to light time and link limits

name: Delay-Tolerant Space Networks
mechanism: Retain data across scheduled or interrupted links with long propagation delays
operating_requirement: Addressed storage, contact plans and compatible endpoints
consequence: Deliver messages after real transmission opportunities rather than instantly

name: Optical Space Links
mechanism: Exchange narrowly directed optical signals between accurately pointed terminals
operating_requirement: Demonstrated optical source, detector, pointing and contact geometry
consequence: Raise potential data throughput while tightening acquisition and pointing limits

name: Interstellar Probe Navigation
mechanism: Navigate a long-duration probe with sparse delayed ground corrections
operating_requirement: Demonstrated propulsion, durable autonomy and long-life power
consequence: Enable bounded mission studies; interstellar arrival is not assumed
